phase_name: Consolidate entry points; retire the second engine

objectives.description: Rewrite deploy-headless.sh: default = bootstrap-safe force-load core + resync_all; --wipe = manager.wipe; header rewritten with durable anchors
objectives.note: Verified via dry-run, fresh-bootstrap deploy (339 files incl. scripts/lib/*), resync, and full --wipe round trip (settings.local.json + .syncprotect path survive) against scratch trees.

objectives.description: Redeploy this repo's own .claude/ via the fixed deploy-headless.sh to prove the harness's deployed-copy resolution path exercises the fix; fix the manifest gap this surfaced (test-deploy-propagation.sh missing from provides.scripts)
objectives.note: verify-deploy.sh: 14/15 (1 pre-existing unrelated finding, formats/summary-format.md line_count, confirmed via git log to predate this task). test-deploy-propagation.sh: 4 passed, 0 failed (was 1 passed/3 failed).

objectives.description: Add [Regenerate] picker entry (entries.lua producer + init.lua handler behind confirmation) wired to manager.wipe
objectives.note: is_regenerate special entry added to create_special_entries; Enter-key handler gates on vim.fn.confirm then calls exts.wipe (manager.wipe). Verified: create_special_entries returns the entry; a full create_picker_entries build against this repo's real structure includes it (247 total entries); a direct manager.wipe scratch-tree round trip via the same call path (exts.wipe({project_dir=...})) confirms settings.local.json survives and 1/1 extensions reload with 0 failures.

objectives.description: Remove is_load_all dead consumer sites (6 sites: init.lua handler + 4 keymap guards + previewer.lua preview branch) and load_all_globally + its exclusively-owned helper chain from sync.lua (NOT scan_all_artifacts, which is non-exclusive -- see plan notes)
objectives.note: init.lua's Enter-key is_load_all block replaced by the [Regenerate] handler (objective 3); its 4 keymap guards had is_load_all swapped for is_regenerate. previewer.lua's is_load_all preview branch, preview_load_all, and its local count_actions helper removed; help text updated to describe [Reload All]/[Regenerate] instead of the retired [Load Core]. sync.lua: load_all_globally + the 5 named helpers (execute_sync, count_actions, audit_synced_content, reinject_loaded_extensions, run_contract_drift_validator) removed, PLUS a second layer of helpers discovered to be transitively exclusive to those 5 (sync_files, detect_untracked, count_by_depth, strip_extension_sections, strip_extension_settings, preserve_sections, restore_sections, read_json, read_file_string, CONFIG_MARKDOWN_FILES, and the state_mod/merge_mod requires) -- traced by following every internal call within each of the 5 named helpers. scan_all_artifacts KEPT deliberately per plan guidance (still tested by sync_spec.lua's 5 cases, all passing unchanged). README.md's stale load_all_globally() doc line replaced. grep -rn 'load_all_globally|is_load_all' lua/ returns nothing (plan's own verification bullet, satisfied literally).

deviations.description: Rewire deploy-headless.sh's default (no-flag) invocation to manager.resync_all
deviations.reason: A bare manager.resync_all default would silently deploy zero files on any target repo whose state file has no 'core' entry -- true of every repo only ever deployed via the retired stateless load_all_globally engine. Default is now manager.load('core', {force=true}) followed by manager.resync_all.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — bootstrap-safety fix, see plan Phase 6 notes)*
